waivers.verdict: Hold — nothing on the wire clears the bar tonight. Tanner McKee inheriting the Eagles' starting job is the week's biggest QB story, but you already have four and none of them are thin; it's not your add.

lineup.verdict: Hold — Jared Goff at QB, Malik Washington at WR, and Will Reichard at K are the right starts; no change needed before kickoff.

trades.verdict: Hold — no trade clears the certainty bar. The roster change was a lineup swap, not a transaction, so your surplus and need are exactly what they were Monday, and nothing league-wide opened up a better deal.

inactives.verdict: Not actionable yet — the earliest Week 7 game is Thursday night; no inactive lists exist to check today.
